description: For integer classes, addition adds coordinates, negation swaps them, multiplication sends (a,b),(c,d) to (ac+bd,ad+bc), and order compares a+d with c+b.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.integer_representative_formulas (a b c d : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.integerAdd (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.integerClass a b)
        (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.integerClass c d) =
      Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.integerClass (a + c) (b + d) ∧
    Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.integerNeg
          (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.integerClass a b) =
        Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.integerClass b a ∧
      Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.integerMul
            (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.integerClass a b)
            (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.integerClass c d) =
          Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.integerClass (a * c + b * d) (a * d + b * c) ∧
        (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.IntegerLE
            (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.integerClass a b)
            (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.integerClass c d) ↔
          a + d ≤ c + b)
